My dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
There is something in [Mr Freeman](/person/523)’s essays that he wants me to look at. Would you be so kind as to let me have them - it is the volume with Charles the Bold in it
I hope the two French histories will come out right at last![^1]
I always suppose some one is making holiday in August so I shall direct this so as to be opened by either you or [Mr Craik](/person/379)

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: E. A. Freeman, who was the editor of the \'Historical Course for Schools\' series, was critical of CMY\'s contribution, the volume on the [History of France](/book/99). His essay on \'Charles the Bold\' was published in the second volume of his Historical Essays (1873). She was also writing another [History of France](/book/353) for Macmillan, in the \'Historical Primers\' series edited by J. R. Green.
